title: Sports radio to try in Malta
intro: Best over-the-air leads for 13–19 October: BBC World Service on DAB+ (block 6A) carries Sportsworld on Sat 17 Oct about 15:06–18:59 and Sun 18 Oct about 16:06–19:59 Malta time, during the Premier League afternoon games. Rai Radio 1 on DAB+ carries Serie A in Italian. NET FM 101 MHz has weekend sports shows. BBC 5 Live is a UK service and was not confirmed as receivable in Malta. Fixture lists below give Malta kickoff times; whether a specific match gets commentary, and whether Kalshi is usable from Malta, still need a same-week check. Reception at the hotel and venue is untested.

records.name: NET FM — FM 101 MHz
records.area: Nationwide licensed FM service in Malta
records.hours: NET FM’s recurring weekly grid lists Hits & Score on Saturday at 16:00 and Sports Box on Sunday at 15:00 (times as published by the Malta station; timezone not explicitly stated). In this trip window those days are 17 and 18 October.
records.description: The Broadcasting Authority’s licensed-stations list gives NET FM at 101 MHz FM. NET FM’s own recurring weekend grid includes two sports programmes. This is the clearest conventional-FM option found, but the weekly grid is not a date-stamped October 2026 schedule and does not confirm match commentary or carriage of a particular event.
records.notes: Re-checked 11 Oct 2026: NET FM’s official programme grid (https://netfm.com.mt/) lists Saturday 16:00 Hits & Score and Sunday 15:00 Sports Box; the frequency is from the Broadcasting Authority list (https://ba.org.mt/stations-licenced). The grid does not state its time zone and is recurring, not a date-stamped trip-week schedule. Recheck the station’s live schedule before travel. No TWC, Gżira United–Mosta, or Rolex Middle Sea Race radio carriage was confirmed.

records.name: Radio Sportiva — DAB+ directory listing
records.area: Malta DAB+ directory; reception not tested at AX ODYCY or BLAST Arena Studios
records.address: Not published; the directory does not state a multiplex block or tuned frequency
records.hours: Radio Sportiva’s recurring grid lists Diretta Sportiva on Saturday and Sunday, 15:05–17:00. Its schedule page says programming may vary with the sporting events of the day. The date-specific live items shown when checked were for 5–11 October, not 13–19 October.
records.description: Digi B Network’s Malta DAB+ channel directory lists Radio Sportiva, an Italian sports station. Radio Sportiva’s own schedule lists weekend sports programming. The Broadcasting Authority’s licensed-stations list does not show Radio Sportiva, and no DAB+ block or tuned frequency for it was found, so treat it as a plausible DAB+ option to scan for by name, not a reception test or a promise of live coverage of a named match.
records.notes: Re-checked 11 Oct 2026. Station schedule (https://www.radiosportiva.com/palinsesto/): “Diretta Sportiva” Saturday and Sunday 15:05–17:00; the page says programming can change with the day’s sporting events and that live programming can run until 24:00 depending on evening big matches (for example Serie A, Coppa Italia, European competitions, national team, or F1/MotoGP). Its dated “Sportiva Live” items visible at check time were for 5–11 October only. DAB+ channel directory (https://dab.com.mt/channels/) lists Radio Sportiva. Digi B’s channel profile (https://dab.com.mt/project/radio-sportiva/) is dated 20 August 2020. Times are as published; Italy and Malta share the same civil time during this trip.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required; hardware price not checked

records.name: Rai Radio 1 — Serie A on “Tutto il calcio minuto per minuto” (DAB+)
records.area: Rai Radio Uno appears in Malta’s DAB+ channel directory; reception not tested locally
records.hours: Rai lists the programme “il sabato e la domenica” (Saturdays and Sundays). Serie A matchday 7 kickoffs in Italy/Malta time: Fri 16 Oct 20:45 Frosinone–Sassuolo; Sat 17 Oct 15:00 Venezia–Napoli, 18:00 Bologna–Inter, 20:45 Roma–Genoa; Sun 18 Oct 12:30 Udinese–Lecce, 15:00 Fiorentina–Como, 18:00 Milan–Atalanta, 20:45 Juventus–Lazio; Mon 19 Oct Monza–Cagliari and Parma–Torino (times not confirmed).
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required; hardware price not checked
records.description: Rai’s official programme page describes “Tutto il calcio minuto per minuto” on Rai Radio 1 as its weekend show covering Serie A and Serie B, including early and late kickoffs. Recent episodes include Saturday-evening Serie A commentary. The 17–18 Oct running order has not been published. Commentary is in Italian. Rai’s press office has announced live Radio 1 commentary of Italian clubs’ Champions League matches in recent seasons (2024–25 and 2025–26). No 2026–27 announcement was found, so midweek carriage on 13–14 Oct is likely but unconfirmed.
records.notes: Checked 11 Oct 2026. Malta DAB+ directory listing for Rai Radio Uno: https://dab.com.mt/channels/. Serie A fixtures and times are from Sky Sport Italia’s report of the Lega Serie A schedule (https://sport.sky.it/calcio/serie-a/calendario-serie-a-anticipi-posticipi-2026-2027-big-match-su-sky); Monday 19 Oct fixtures are from https://www.romatoday.it/sport/calcio/calendario-serie-a-2026-2027-diretta-partite-date.html . Rai press-office Champions League radio announcement (2025–26 season): https://www.rai.it/ufficiostampa/assets/template/us-articolo.html?ssiPath=%2Farticoli%2F2025%2F08%2FUna-Champions-minuto-per-minuto-76eaca14-b4fb-4f38-a33b-efebedaf38b9-ssi.html . Italian clubs on UCL matchday 2 (UEFA): Inter v Club Brugge and Villarreal v Napoli (Tue 13 Oct 21:00), Feyenoord v Como (Wed 14 Oct 18:45), Roma v Real Madrid (Wed 14 Oct 21:00). Italy and Malta use the same time zone.

records.name: BBC World Service — DAB+ listing and Sportsworld dates
records.area: BBC World Service appears in Malta’s DAB+ channel directory; reception not tested locally
records.address: Not published; this is a broadcast listing, not a visitor venue
records.hours: BBC’s official episode pages (re-read 11 Oct 2026) list Sportsworld on Saturday 17 October at 13:06 GMT and Sunday 18 October at 14:06 GMT, each 3 hours 53 minutes. In Malta time (UTC+2) that is about 15:06–18:59 on Saturday and 16:06–19:59 on Sunday.
records.description: The Malta DAB+ channel directory includes BBC World Service. The BBC’s dated listing schedules Sportsworld (“live sport from around the world”) on both playoff-weekend days. Those windows overlap the 16:00 Malta-time Premier League kickoffs on Saturday 17 Oct and Nottingham Forest v Arsenal (17:30) on Sunday 18 Oct. Which match, if any, gets live commentary is not yet published. The 11 Oct episode carried live commentary of Liverpool v Man City, but that is a precedent, not a promise. Neither the directory nor the schedule proves reception at the hotel or venue.
records.notes: Malta DAB+ directory listing for BBC World Service: https://dab.com.mt/channels/. Dated BBC programme pages, both re-read 11 Oct 2026: Saturday 17 October, https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c92ck0m2cw ; Sunday 18 October, https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c92ck0q313 (3 hours 53 minutes each; feed “BBC World Service except News Internet”). The episode pages render times in the viewer’s local zone; the fetch showed 09:06 and 10:06 US Eastern (UTC−4), i.e. 13:06 and 14:06 GMT. Precedent episode with Premier League commentary: https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c9208pxyf8 (11 Oct 2026). Upcoming list: https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/p002w5vq/broadcasts/upcoming . WorldDAB’s technical listing and the reception caveat are recorded separately.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required for radio reception; hardware price not checked

records.name: AM / medium wave — no current sports broadcast verified
records.hours: No current AM/MW sports schedule was verified for 13–19 October 2026.
records.description: No current AM or medium-wave sports station was confirmed. The Broadcasting Authority’s licensed-stations page (checked 11 Oct 2026) lists FM, DAB+ and community-radio services and no AM/MW station. A 2026 TVM News history says Radju Malta began on 999 MW and changed to 93.7 FM in 1979; that historic reference is not evidence of a current AM service.
records.notes: The current Broadcasting Authority licensed-stations list was checked on 11 Oct 2026 (https://ba.org.mt/stations-licenced). Absence from the list is not a guarantee that no distant AM signal can ever be received; do not rely on an AM sports programme without current station confirmation. Historical context: https://tvmnews.mt/en/news/radju-malta-is-53-years-old/.

records.name: Kalshi — trading while in Malta (check eligibility first)
records.area: Applies to use from Malta, 13–19 Oct
records.description: Kalshi’s help centre says trading from outside the US, and using Kalshi while travelling, is allowed only where consistent with the eligibility and geographic requirements of the Kalshi Member Agreement. It does not say whether Malta is supported, and this guide did not check the Member Agreement’s country list. Confirm in the app or agreement before the trip. Which of the fixtures on this page have Kalshi markets was not checked either.
records.notes: Checked 11 Oct 2026. The help article also lists debit card (Visa/Mastercard), wire transfer (minimum $1,000) and cryptocurrency as international deposit methods, depending on region. This guide does not recommend using a VPN or any other way around location checks.

records.category: UK national radio — football listing (Malta reception not verified)
records.area: United Kingdom BBC service; reception or streaming in Malta not established
records.hours: The BBC's upcoming-broadcasts page, checked 11 Oct, shows Premier League commentary with the labels 'Today', 'Next Saturday' and 'Next Sunday' and no calendar date for those items. The dated entries shown are Sat 24 Oct (14:55, 15:00, 17:30 UK time) and Sun 25 Oct (14:00, 16:30 UK time), which fall after the trip. Malta is one hour ahead of UK time in this period (CEST, UTC+2, versus BST, UTC+1).
records.description: The BBC's Premier League Football programme page lists live 5 Live and 5 Live Sports Extra commentary for 2026–27 fixtures. It is a UK public-broadcaster listing. It is not a Malta frequency, DAB+ block, or streaming-availability check, and it does not confirm that the feed can be received in Malta or that any named fixture is broadcast on 17–18 October.
records.notes: The 'Next Saturday' and 'Next Sunday' entries are not mapped to 17–18 October in the snapshot checked; that mapping is an inference and must be confirmed on the BBC page on the day. BBC Sounds/stream access from Malta was not tested and must not be assumed. The user's 'Kalshi-market' framing was not verified: no Kalshi market or Malta broadcast-rights deal was checked (official EPL kickoffs for 17–19 October are in the fixture record). Third-party TV listings (not radio) show Premier League rights for Melita/GO TSN channels; they were not used as radio evidence.
records.price range: Not applicable (listing); receiver and streaming costs not checked
